subject: Commit scrub & save-plan runbook for Argonaut — owners + escape options
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Commit scrub & save-plan runbook for Argonaut — owners + escape options

Team — quick one. Argonaut wants to close this quarter but procurement pushed back on our standard PO window and requested a 60‑day start date. Finance wants a firm commit for Q3 recognition. I need a short, executable save-plan and clear owners so we don't lose the commit.

Key asks (can each owner reply with ETA by EOD Monday?):
- Marissa: confirm final list of technical blockers Argonaut still needs signoff on, and whether we can support a staged go‑live (pilot first 10 seats).
- Sean: pricing fallback options if they require a 60‑day start — can we offer a temporary credit or shorter ramp pricing?
- Neha: confirm contract exceptions they request (SLA start date clause) and whether legal can accept a start milestone tie instead of calendar start.

Attached a starting pricing draft and a quick owner grid — fill the grid, highlight any absolute no‑gos in red. I will compile and send the mutual action plan to Jordan.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Commit scrub & save-plan runbook for Argonaut — owners + escape options

Irene — quick notes after the discovery call with Argonaut yesterday:
- Technical blockers: SSO profile mapping (workflows), additional logging fields for audit (they want field-level access logs), and a request for a private VPC option (they said may be required by procurement).
- Pilot path: we can do a 10-seat pilot in their dev account in 2 weeks; VPC/private options add ~3–4 weeks and require infra review.

I'll update the owner grid with these timelines. Nothing is an outright blocker to start a pilot. Marking "pilot" as GREEN, VPC as YELLOW (needs infra).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Commit scrub & save-plan runbook for Argonaut — owners + escape options

Irene / team — pricing/fiscal options:
- Option A (standard): Start date aligned to PO receipt; full list price.
- Option B (bridge): Allow a 30‑day credit buffer on initial invoice, convert to standard pricing after pilot completes — this can be 15% credit (one‑time) instead of discounted list.
- Option C (deferred recognition): Push start milestone to first API call (requires Legal signoff).

My recommendation: propose Option B publicly (conservative revenue impact, eases procurement), and keep Option C as a legal fallback. I'll attach a recalculated ARR impact and runway.

SG
Sean Gallagher
Sales Director
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@argonaut.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@argonaut.io
Date: 2027-06-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit scrub & save-plan runbook for Argonaut — owners + escape options

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the rapid turnaround. A couple of items from procurement/legal side:
- They will not sign a contract that recognizes revenue before services start. A 60‑day lead time is our current policy.
- They asked whether Redwood can commit to a pilot-based acceptance with a signaling commit (we do first invoice upon successful pilot).
- Can you share a version of the pricing that isolates pilot billing and shows the credit approach (Option B) clearly?

Jordan Ellis
Head of Procurement
Argonaut Systems
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@argonaut.io>, procurement@argonaut.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Commit scrub & save-plan runbook for Argonaut — owners + escape options

Jordan — thanks for the clarity. Short summary and proposed mutual action plan:
1) Pilot first (10 seats) — Redwood to provision pilot environment within 10 business days (Marissa owner). Pilot acceptance = first invoice trigger.
2) Bridge credit — Redwood offers a one‑time 15% credit on the first month invoice if the PO requires a 60‑day lead time (Sean owner to confirm final credit mechanics). This preserves your procurement window while giving sales a pathway to near‑term recognition.
3) VPC option — we will treat VPC as an add-on that can be delivered in a separate work order; timeline 3–4 weeks post‑contract (Neha owns feasibility + contract language).
4) Mandatory items for signature: scoped pilot definition, acceptance criteria, billing trigger tied to pilot acceptance, and an explicit timeline for VPC delivery if requested.

We will attach the updated pricing (RDW_Argonaut_Pricing_V3.pdf) and a one‑page owner grid that highlights RED/YELLOW/GREEN items (attached). If that aligns, Marissa and Sean — please confirm the pilot provisioning ETA and final wording for the billing trigger so I can share a mutual action plan doc and a DocuSign link.

Irene Choi
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: RDW_Argonaut_Pricing_V3.pdf (pdf), save-plan-owner-grid.xlsx (xlsx)
